raw_output:
Giver: Hello?
Follower: Hi there.
Giver: Okay, let's do this. You have the map with the cross?
Follower: Yes, right here. Where do we start?
Giver: Start at the cross. You know your map only has the start, right?
Follower: Yeah, just the cross.
Giver: Okay, look for a burnt forest near the start. It should be to your left.
Follower: Ah, I see a dark patch. Is that the one?
Giver: Yes. Now, from the cross, head down and slightly left towards it. Don't go all the way to it, just pass close.
Follower: So, towards the left?
Giver: Left of the start, but before you reach the forest. Keep going.
Follower: Okay... I'm moving towards the forest now.
Giver: Good. Now, once you're past the forest, turn right. We need to go up a bit.
Follower: Turning right. Up a little.
Giver: Keep going up until you see a small village in the distance on your left.
Follower: Ah, I see a little cluster of huts. That's it?
Giver: Yes, that's the remote village. Stop there. Don't pass it.
Follower: Okay, stopping here.
Giver: Now turn left. We need to go towards a ravine, but not right into it.
Follower: Left... towards the ravine?
Giver: Yes, the ravine is on your right side of the path. Aim for the area left of the ravine.
Follower: I'm turning left. It looks steep here.
Giver: That's right, keep walking left until you hit a pine grove.
Follower: There's a pine grove! Okay, stopping there.
Giver: Great. Now turn right. Go down towards the boat house.
Follower: Turning right. Heading down.
Giver: Wait, don't go straight to the boat house yet. There's a ravine coming up on your right first. Go up to it, then turn left.
Follower: Whoa, okay, I missed that ravine. So up to the ravine, then left?
Giver: Yes. Aim for a spot that puts the ravine on your right.
Follower: Okay, so the ravine is there... turning left.
Giver: Good. Now, follow that path until you see the pine grove again. Wait, no, we already passed the pine grove.
Follower: Wait, we passed the pine grove already?
Giver: Yes, that was the first pine grove. We are going down from the ravine towards a boat house.
Follower: Ah, okay. So the ravine is on the right, and we're heading down to the boat house.
Giver: Yes. Go down until you see the boat house on your right.
Follower: Okay, heading down. I see a boat house shape.
Giver: Yes, that's it. Stop right next to it.
Follower: Stopped.
Giver: Now, turn left. There's another boat house further down, but we don't go there yet. Go left towards the coast.
Follower: Left towards the water?
Giver: Yes, towards the pebbled shore. But stop before the shore starts. We need to find a specific spot.
Follower: Okay, left... I see some pebbles.
Giver: Good. Now look at your map. Do you see a hidden thing somewhere?
Follower: I see a little shelter. Is that it?
Giver: No, that's not it. Look to your right. Do you see a pine grove?
Follower: Yes, there's a pine grove to my right.
Giver: Okay, so you're at the boat house? No, wait. Let me rephrase.
Follower: Wait, I'm confused. Are we at the boat house or near the shore?
Giver: We are leaving the boat house. Go left. You'll see a pine grove on your left.
Follower: Ah! The pine grove is on the left now. Okay, moving left.
Giver: Yes. Keep going until you see the boat house on your right again.
Follower: Okay, heading left. I see the boat house on my right.
Giver: Perfect. Stop there. Now, turn left. We need to go towards the coast again.
Follower: Left towards the coast.
Giver: Yes. Follow the shore. Stop near the crane bay.
Follower: Okay, following the shore. I see the crane bay.
Giver: Good. Now turn right. There's a coconut palm nearby.
Follower: Turning right. I see a tall palm tree.
Giver: Yes, the coconut palm is on your right. Stop there.
Follower: Stopped.
Giver: Now, turn left. Go towards the beach again.
Follower: Left towards the beach.
Giver: Yes. Keep going until you see the pebbled shore. Stop just before it gets too crowded.
Follower: Okay, left. I see the pebbles.
Giver: Good. Now, look down. Is there a flag ship on your map?
Follower: Yes! I see a ship shape at the bottom.
Giver: Great. We need to go down towards it. Turn right slightly, heading towards the ship.
Follower: Turning right. Heading down.
Giver: Yes. Go all the way down until you see the flag ship.
Follower: Okay, heading down. I see the ship!
Giver: Almost there. Don't touch the ship yet. Go a little left of it.
Follower: Left of the ship.
Giver: Yes. Now, head left again towards the edge of the map.
Follower: Left towards the edge.
Giver: Good. Keep going left until you see washed stones or something similar.
Follower: I don't see washed stones here. Is there another landmark?
Giver: Wait, let me check. Ah, there's a washed stones area on your map?
Follower: Yes, I do see washed stones further down.
Giver: Okay, so go left past the ship, then turn up towards the washed stones.
Follower: Okay, left of the ship. Turning up.
Giver: Yes. Aim for the washed stones. Stop there.
Follower: Stopped.
Giver: Now turn left. We need to go to the finish line.
Follower: Left.
Giver: Go left until you can't go any further. That's the finish.
Follower: Okay, heading left. I'm reaching the edge of the map.
Giver: Perfect. You made it!
Follower: Done! The route is drawn.
